exposure: Admission to hospital from community birth eligible group
outcome: Community birth (home and birth center) rates
cohort: The study included 2983 birthing people who self-identified as Asian within the American Association of Birth Centers Perinatal Data Registry (PDR) between 2007 and 2021.
finding: The study found lower rates of cesarean birth among Asians who birthed in PDR user sites compared to the national average, yet Asian multiparous birthing people had 1.5 greater odds of cesarean birth compared to White multiparous birthing people.
mod_finding: Asian multiparous birthing people had 1.5 greater odds of cesarean birth compared to White multiparous birthing people, and those admitted to the hospital from the community birth eligible group had five times higher odds of cesarean birth.
